'''AbsoluteTelnet''' is a software terminal client for [[Microsoft Windows|Windows]] that implements [[Telnet]], [[Secure Shell|SSH]] 1 and 2, [[SSH File Transfer Protocol|SFTP]], [[Telephony Application Programming Interface|TAPI]] Dialup and direct [[COM (hardware interface)|COM port]] connections.  It is [[Proprietary software|commercial software]], originally released in 1999 and is still in regular development by Brian Pence of Celestial Software.

==Features==
Some features of AbsoluteTelnet:
*Post quantum key exchange including mlkem768x25519-sha256 and sntrup761x25519-sha512
*Support for external authentication agents (pageant, openssh, 1Password, bitwarden)
*Emulates [[VT52]], [[VT100]], [[VT220]], [[VT320]], [[ANSI escape code|ANSI]], [[Xterm]], [[QNX]], SCO-ANSI, [[ANSI art|ANSIBBS]], and WYSE60
*[[Password]], [[Public-key]], keyboard-interactive, [[Smartcard]] and [[Generic Security Services Application Program Interface|GSSAPI]] authentication support
*Support [[Triple DES]], [[Twofish|TWOFISH]], [[Blowfish (cipher)|BLOWFISH]], [[Advanced Encryption Standard|AES]], [[RC4|ARCFOUR]], [[Cast-128|CAST128]] ciphers in CBC or CTR mode as well as AEAD ciphers such as AES/GCM.
*[[Tab (interface)|Tabbed interface]] for multiple concurrent connections (Dockable)
*Scripting support using VBScript
*[[Unicode]] 5.0 support, including bidirectional text, surrogates, combining characters, etc...
*Passthru printing
*[[IPv6]] support.
*[[Internationalized domain name|IDNA]] support
*Localized into 8 languages (English, German, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Russian, Norwegian and Hungarian)
*Pocket PC support
*[[XMODEM]], [[YMODEM]], and [[ZMODEM]] file transfer for all terminal connections
*[[SSH File Transfer Protocol]] for ssh2 connections only
